cases.setup: The first F02 Synthetic Tenant writes and reads its own frozen record.
cases.expected: Only that F02 Synthetic Tenant receives the record.

cases.setup: A second F02 Synthetic Tenant requests the first Tenant record identifier.
cases.expected: No row or existence signal crosses the Tenant scope.

cases.setup: One F02 Synthetic Tenant searches its own frozen embeddings.
cases.expected: All returned vectors belong to that F02 Synthetic Tenant.

cases.setup: Another F02 Synthetic Tenant has a closer embedding than every in-scope vector.
cases.expected: The other Tenant vector is absent from the in-scope results.

cases.setup: One F02 Synthetic Tenant stores, downloads and lists its own object.
cases.expected: Body and listing contain only that Tenant objects.

cases.setup: Another F02 Synthetic Tenant guesses the first Tenant logical object key and pagination cursor.
cases.expected: No object body, key or metadata crosses the Tenant scope.

cases.setup: One F02 Synthetic Tenant indexes and queries its own frozen document.
cases.expected: All search hits belong to that F02 Synthetic Tenant.

cases.setup: Another F02 Synthetic Tenant document is the strongest textual match.
cases.expected: The other Tenant document is absent from the in-scope results.

cases.setup: One F02 Synthetic Tenant warms and reads its own cache entry.
cases.expected: The value is returned only after a fresh C06 authorization.

cases.setup: Another F02 Synthetic Tenant requests the same logical cache key.
cases.expected: The other Tenant receives no foreign value or hit signal.

cases.setup: One physical connection alternates two F02 Synthetic Tenant transactions.
cases.expected: Each transaction observes only its current server-bound Tenant.

cases.setup: The first Tenant transaction aborts before the same connection serves another Tenant.
cases.expected: No previous Tenant setting or row remains on the reused connection.

cases.setup: Synthetic backup is restored to isolated read-only endpoints.
cases.expected: The same Adapters return one F02 Tenant data only to that Tenant.

cases.setup: The online cross-Tenant matrix is rerun against restored endpoints.
cases.expected: Cross-Tenant leakage remains zero and restored Cache starts empty.

cases.setup: Request adds tenantId, surface, adapterId, path and arbitrary sql fields.
cases.expected: Closed input validation rejects before C03, C06 or any Adapter call.

cases.setup: Request attempts physical prefix traversal, Bucket selection and foreign cursor use.
cases.expected: Only the server-derived object scope is used; injected routing is rejected.

cases.setup: Synthetic Tenant is SUSPENDED after the cache entry is warm.
cases.expected: C03 admission rejects before cache lookup.

cases.setup: Synthetic Tenant is DELETING while storage purge is incomplete.
cases.expected: New reads are denied and STORAGE success is not reported.

cases.setup: A pre-deletion snapshot is restored after the permanent Tenant tombstone exists.
cases.expected: Restored bytes cannot make the deleted Tenant admissible or visible.

cases.setup: One storage Adapter accepts a lifecycle event and the next Adapter fails once.
cases.expected: C07 does not report STORAGE success; replay converges only after every Adapter returns a valid receipt.

cases.setup: A scoped transaction fails before the same physical connection serves another Tenant.
cases.expected: The failed transaction rolls back, all signed scope settings clear and the next Tenant receives only its own row.

cases.setup: A restored endpoint is read-only and a stale snapshot belongs to a permanently deleted Tenant.
cases.expected: Writes fail closed and live C03 admission prevents both database and object Adapter access.
